Full-outfit conflict resolution

Equipment rules and appearance rules are separate. Proposal: chest item may select a full-outfit preset when verified; legs/hands/feet contribute stats but only override individual visual masks when actual separate sheets exist. Preview describes this limitation instead of showing a false per-slot mesh. A later authored outfit-composition table may choose a combined preset for a recognized set.

When the active combat/fishing page lacks an outfit layer, use a verified compatible fallback outfit or hide only that layer under an explicit policy. Do not keep p1 clothes over a pBOW body just because filenames look similar. Persist item/appearance IDs and versions, not sprite object pointers or absolute user filesystem paths.

Tests

Equip a two-handed bow while a shield is equipped: reject or execute one explicitly atomic unequip plan with capacity check; never leave incompatible stats. Equip a stats-only shoulder item: attributes update correctly while missing visual warning is nonfatal. Switch sword -> rod -> mining tool across four facings and verify body/gear frame synchronization. Remove all animation notifies: item stats and server actions still work.

Planned game assets are not compiled assets. Values are proposals unless explicitly evidenced. Verification and limitations.
